description: End of the P0 promise: on a bare folder with no config and no index, init synthesizes agsc.config.json and content/index.md whose every value is schema-valid — site.base is the http://localhost/ development placeholder that AGSC-01-19 and config.schema.json admit, build.out is www/, the index title passes the 3-120 bound and its description the 40-200 bound — so the very next command, ci, exits 0 offline. Findings are warnings only, including AGSC-E506 telling the owner to set a real site.base before publishing. If this vector exits non-zero the three-command promise of PRD-053 is broken at step two.
